granted-by.background-auto:
Background (Auto)

{proficiency}

This proficiency is automatically provided by the Background Item. This only considers skills listed in the details tab, and not rule elements.
granted-by.background-manual:
Background (Manual)

{proficiency}

You have manually marked this skill as trained by the character's Background. It is improved to trained, and this improvement is not considered for the allocation cap.
granted-by.class-auto:
Class (Auto)

{proficiency}

This proficiency is automatically provided by the Class Item. This only considers skills listed in the details tab, and not rule elements.
granted-by.class-manual:
Class (Manual)

{proficiency}

You have manually marked this skill as trained by the character's Class. It is improved to trained, and this improvement is not considered for the allocation cap.
granted-by.paragon-skill:
Skill Paragon / Additional Lore

{proficiency}

You have manually marked this skill as a paragon skill or a Lore granted by Additional Lore feat. It automatically becomes trained, then gets improved to expert on level 3, master on level 7 and legendary on level 13.
granted-by.source:
Source

{proficiency}

This proficiency was manually set in the source data on the character's sheet.

locked-because.no-valid-upgrade-rank: The skill is already at the highest proficiency level for this character level.
locked-because.exhausted-allowance: You have reached the maximum number of improvements you can choose at this level.

config.background-skill-manual-hint: Selected skills/Lores will be marked as granted by Background, in addition to those automatically marked by the corresponding setting. They are automatically improved to trained, and this improvement is not considered for the allocation cap.
config.class-skill-manual-hint: Selected skills/Lores will be marked as granted by Class, in addition to those automatically marked by the corresponding setting. They are automatically improved to trained, and this improvement is not considered for the allocation cap.
config.choice-cap-override-hint: Changes the number of skills you can improve at a given level. Overriden values will be marked with an exclamation mark in the header row. Clear a field to disable the override.
config.mark-auto-background-class: Automatically mark improvements by Background and Class
config.mark-auto-background-class-hint: In addition to marking skills improved in source, will also mark those that are automatically improved by character's background and class. Defaults to false, as it currently ignores rule elements and only uses data from the details tab, and may seem inconsistent.
config.paragon-skill-hint: Selected skills/Lores automatically become trained, then get improved to expert on level 3, master on level 7 and legendary on level 13, and this improvement will not be considered for the allocation cap.
config.plan-ahead-level-cap-hint: Allows preplanning all allocations in advance up to the chosen level. They won't take effect until you reach the required level.
